name: BoxPaint
description: A CSS box's (or CSS artboard's) paint rectangle: its own paints draw at this size, centred on its border box, in place of the border box. Each axis is a length-percentage of the border box (points plus a percentage), recomputed at each layout; at rest it is the border box. Layout, the content clip, hit testing and semantics ignore it.

width.description: The painted box's width: its points part, added to widthPercent of the border box's width.

widthPercent.description: The painted box's width: its percentage of the border box's width, added to width. A negative result counts as 0.

height.description: The painted box's height: its points part, added to heightPercent of the border box's height.

heightPercent.description: The painted box's height: its percentage of the border box's height, added to height. A negative result counts as 0.
